system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Repeated network logon failures for svc-render occurred on FILE-NWD-01 from 13:36:34 through 13:51:27 UTC. The events report bad-password status 0xc000006a and identify FILE-NWD-01 as the workstation.

Domain-controller records corroborate failed validation attempts for svc-render, including NTLM validation failures with status 0xc000006a and Kerberos pre-authentication failures with status 0x18, from the same source address shown in the FILE-NWD-01 failures.

The roughly minute-spaced failures from FILE-NWD-01 are consistent with the supplied context that RenderQueue runs and re-authenticates every minute, and that svc-render's password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC with a manual job update required. This makes a stale job credential a plausible explanation, but does not prove it.

Explicit-credential events show SYSTEM running Meridian OpsAgent with svc-render as the target account on WS-LMARTINS-01 targeting PROXY-NWD-01, and later on WS-NBLAKE-01 targeting FILE-NWD-01. The available context does not explain these uses of svc-render from those workstations.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not cover the full requested window through 14:20 UTC; the latest provided event is at 13:56:51 UTC.
The records show failed authentication attempts but provide no corresponding successful-logon, process execution, or account-use history.
The records identify OpsAgent by path and process name but do not establish whether it is authorized, what initiated it, or why it used svc-render.
The supplied evidence does not include RenderQueue job configuration, password-rotation completion records, or proxy and network activity details.
claims_not_established: Whether the repeated failures were caused by the expected post-rotation job configuration error or by malicious activity.
Whether either explicit-credential use of svc-render on WS-LMARTINS-01 or WS-NBLAKE-01 was authorized.
Whether svc-render authentication succeeded at any point during the review window.
Whether any account or host was compromised, or who initiated the activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm whether the svc-render password rotation occurred at 13:30 UTC and inspect RenderQueue's credential configuration and run history.

Determine whether Meridian OpsAgent is approved and deployed on WS-LMARTINS-01 and WS-NBLAKE-01; collect its configuration, parent-process, and execution logs around the two explicit-credential events.
Collect successful and failed authentication records for svc-render, including relevant logon events, from FILE-NWD-01, DC-NWD-01, and the two workstations for the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
Review PROXY-NWD-01 logs around 13:23 UTC and FILE-NWD-01 network and process telemetry around 13:56 UTC to establish what those requests did and whether they were expected.
